title: CDMElicitationOutput
description: Structured output from a CDM elicitation interview, ready to write into SKILL.md v2 metadata block.

skill_id.description: ID of the skill being elicited or created (kebab-case)

recognition_cues.description: Textual/contextual signals that trigger recognition of this skill

expectancies.description: Observable outcomes within the session that confirm correct application

decision_cues.description: Per-branch CCI entries — minimum 3 to clear science-only-risk

branch.description: Which Decision Point branch this cue gates

cue.description: The perceptual signal that triggers this branch

indicates.description: What the signal means about the situation

adaptive_workarounds.description: Context-sensitive departures from the documented procedure

new_skill_draft.description: True if this elicitation produced a new skill (pattern_extension), false if it updated an existing one

proposed_name.description: Proposed skill ID for new skills (kebab-case). Null for updates.

which_expectancy_violated.description: For expectancy_violation triggers: which expectancy text failed

not_for_extension.description: For expectancy_violation triggers: proposed NOT-FOR clause addition
